spec_match.rationale: Builds DecisionModelCreateCoreOptions exactly as the explainer and in-review IDL define them (context, expectedInputs, typed questions with option label/description) and validates against the explainer's documented constraints, deferring final authority to the platform's own availability() errors.

interactive.rationale: Add/remove/edit question cards with live id/prompt/options inputs; verdict list, JSON emission and the real availability() call all react to every keystroke or click.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises interactive schema building, explainer-rule validation, JSON output and a real availability() run; all four are on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Validates missing/duplicate ids, empty prompts, choice without options, single-option questions, the 2–16 practical band, non-numeric score labels (with the ordinal-fallback consequence), and still allows asking the platform with problems present — labelled as such.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5155080092385280 and the explainer's detailed-design section.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's availability-enum assertion pins the call this page makes; honest 0/6 on 141 matches the page's thrown-ReferenceError state.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP driver: added a boolean question (verdict updated to 3 questions valid), cleared an id (verdict flipped to the id problem), ran the real availability() call and saw the verbatim ReferenceError; console clean, no failed requests, 0px overflow both classes. Partial: platform-side schema rejection text requires a provider.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the availability branch (enum-validated) and the absent/rejected branch distinctly, recording client-side problem counts.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; ghost buttons flip background and colour together; problem list rose-on-paper with an emerald valid state; type tags black-on-ivory inverse.

accessibility.rationale: Every generated input gets a real label/for pair, remove buttons carry aria-labels naming their question, the problems list is aria-live=polite, JSON block is a labelled focusable pre, clipboard failure has a text fallback path.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Question cards are single-column grids with wrapping mono textareas; harness ok/ok at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800 with clean console.

openQuestions.title: Compare client-side validation with the platform's real errors
openQuestions.detail: Once a provider exists, submit schemas that violate each rule (choice without options, 17 options, duplicate ids) and record the platform's actual exception types/messages next to the page's advisory verdicts, adjusting copy if the platform is stricter or looser.

guidanceConsulted.query: dynamically generated form fields labels and validation announcements
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Generated inputs need programmatic labels; validation summaries should announce politely and persist visibly; destructive controls need accessible names.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each generated field wires label[for] to a unique id, the problems list is the single polite region and stays rendered, and every remove button is aria-labelled with its question id.

guidanceConsulted.query: editable card list layout that stays single-column on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid gap-based card stacks with intrinsic widths; avoid fixed multi-column editors on narrow screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Question cards are a one-column grid with wrapping headers and full-width fields; verified no overflow at 360px.

summary: Interactive schema builder for the proposed DecisionModel options dictionary: explainer-rule validation live on every edit, exact JSON emission, and a real availability() call that defers to the platform. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium-141 CDP driver (no chrome-devtools-mcp here): validation state transitions exercised, honest ReferenceError on the real call, clean console, ok/ok responsive.
